abstract: An infectious etiology of testicular cancer has been suggested. We have evaluated seroreactivity against cytomegalovirus (CMV) and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) in relation to testicular-cancer risk in a case-control study, nested within a cohort of prospectively collected serum specimens from 293,692 individuals. For each of 81 cases of testicular cancer identified, 3 controls were randomly selected from the cohort. Serum IgG antibody titers against CMV and EBV were determined using enzyme-linked immunosorbent assays (ELISAs) and immunofluorescence methods. Odds ratios (OR) were obtained from conditional logistic-regression models. No association was found between CMV positivity and testicular cancer overall (OR = 1.08; 95% confidence interval 0.60-1.94); risk for testicular seminoma was increased among CMV seropositive [OR = 1.70 (0.80-3.59)], whereas seropositivity was associated with decreased risk for testicular non-seminoma [OR = 0.54 (0.19-1.56)] (p for heterogeneity, 0.09). For EBV, the risk for testicular cancer was increased among individuals seropositive for viral capsid antigen (VCA) [OR = 2.74 (0.62-12.12)]. The results lend some support to the hypothesis of an infectious etiology, and we propose that future studies should take into account age at infection.
abstract_ja: 精巣がんの感染起因が示唆されてきた。293,692人の前向きに収集された血清検体のコホート内で、精巣がん81例についてネステッド症例対照研究を行い、CMVおよびEBVの血清反応性を評価した。各症例に対し対照を3例ランダムに選択した。CMVおよびEBVに対するIgG抗体価をELISAおよび免疫蛍光法で測定した。オッズ比は条件付きロジスティック回帰モデルから求めた。CMVと精巣がん全体との関連は認められなかった(OR = 1.08; 95%信頼区間 0.60-1.94)。CMV血清陽性では精巣セミノーマのリスクが上昇し [OR = 1.70 (0.80-3.59)]、精巣非セミノーマのリスクは低下した [OR = 0.54 (0.19-1.56)](不均一性のp値 0.09)。EBVについては、ウイルスカプシド抗原(VCA)陽性者で精巣がんリスクの上昇が認められた [OR = 2.74 (0.62-12.12)]。本結果は感染起因仮説をある程度支持するものであり、今後の研究では感染時の年齢を考慮すべきであると提案する。
